overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Kaskinen 6 Person Hybrid Outdoor Sauna offers a luxurious and versatile wellness retreat right in your backyard. Combining the benefits of PureTech™ Full Spectrum infrared technology and a traditional stove, this sauna provides a customizable experience for muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Its all-weather exterior and Canadian Red Cedar interior ensure durability and comfort, while the interior LED control panel with Bluetooth connectivity and built-in speakers enhances your relaxation with personalized music. Ideal for outdoor installation, this sauna is perfect for those seeking a premium, spa-like experience at home.

Product Ad-Copy: With a Golden Designs all-weather exterior outdoor Hybrid (Traditional Stove or Full Spectrum Infrared) sauna, you can turn that dream of your very own home spa into a reality. Even where space is at a premium, you can still enjoy the good life in the form of a delightfully relaxing and invigorating steam sauna in the comfort of your own home.
Our Barn Series brings even more relaxation with an all-natural Canadian Red Cedar interior finish, providing an invigorating rich aroma to your sauna session.

Golden Designs outdoor Hybrid (Traditional Stove or Full Spectrum Infrared) saunas provides a healthier way to live. Enjoy the wealth of health benefits a traditional or full spectrum infrared sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to a healthier life!!
